name: 上采样伪影检测
description: 检测 伪影 from upsampling operations used in GAN generators. These 伪影 create periodic 模式 in the 频域.
mechanism: 分析 频域 for periodic 模式 caused by transposed convolution or upsampling layers in generative models.
parameters: Search: 频域 peaks, Pattern: periodic 伪影
source: Chandrasegaran et al. (2021), GAN Upsampling Artifacts
useCase: Detecting GAN upsampling 伪影 in generated images

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Kirchner, M. & Böhme, R. (2008). Hiding Traces of Resampling in Digital Images. IEEE TIFS.
Gallagher, A.C. (2005). Detection of Linear and Cubic Interpolation in JPEG Compressed Images. CCECE.

strengths:
• 检测 interpolation 模式 from upscaling operations
• Effective for both traditional and neural upsampling
• Frequency 分析 reveals periodic interpolation 伪影
• Can identify specific upsampling algorithms
• 适用于任何图像格式
limitations:
• High-quality AI upscalers minimize detectable 伪影
• Anti-aliasing can mask interpolation 模式
• Original native-分辨率 images show no 伪影
• JPEG压缩 adds confounding frequency components
• Requires sufficient image size for 分析
